text:
Ana B: quick q  for the console charts: do we prefer `/s` or `req/s` on the y-axis? current panels look cramped with p95 and color legends.
Theo R: `/s` is concise. tooltip can show full text.
PM-Rita: product wants clarity for non-engr users. `req/s` is fine if we can keep axis density.
Kai M: proposal: axis use `/s`, compact legend uses `req/s`, tooltip and axis hover show `Requests per second (req/s)`. keeps both worlds.
Ana B: smoothing + legend issue: toggling smoothing currently duplicates lines in legend and increases height. idea: when smoothing enabled collapse the raw entry to a smaller, muted row with "Show raw" affordance.
Theo R: yes. accessibility: collapsed rows must be keyboard-focusable with aria-expanded and an accessible name like "Raw series hidden".
AccessibilityBot: A11Y note: use aria-live to announce "Outlier de-emphasis enabled" when toggled; don't rely solely on color/opacity. Also ensure faded points still reachable by keyboard.
Kai M: on outliers: two approaches discussed  clip at percentile (changes scale) or visually fade isolated spikes (keep data). prefer fade to avoid hiding incidents.
PM-Rita: agree, product prefers fade but wants microcopy that users understand.
Ana B: copy suggestion: label: "De-emphasize outliers" helper: "Fade isolated spikes visually; values unchanged." short and clear.
Theo R: small CSS idea for collapsed legend:
```
.legend--muted { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; }
.legend--muted .action { text-decoration: underline; }
```
Keep visible focus ring.
Kai M: keyboard flow: `L` to focus legend, arrows to move, Enter to expand/collapse. Document in shortcuts modal.
PM-Rita: feature flag plan: behind `console.featureFlags.outlierFade` rollout to beta orgs. collect feedback on whether clipping is ever preferred.
Ana B: I'll attach a figma mock and open a PR with prop `deEmphasizeOutliers: boolean`. Will include aria strings and tooltip copy.
AccessibilityBot: include unit tests for legend keyboard navigation and an a11y test that asserts aria-live message on toggle.
Ana B: thanks all 60a will post mock link shortly.
